Senses.Explanation: A fixed concession formula that marks the move the speaker has no way to refuse, then spends it. Linji Yixuan mounts the prefect's seat only by bending to the gathering, for in the founders' gate the great matter leaves no room to open the mouth or set a foot, Changsha Jingcen would rather let the hall grow grass waist-deep, and only because he has no way out opens the eye of the ten directions in which no one is not oneself, Fenyang Shanzhao writes the old worthies' east-talk and west-talk off as forced on them by their hearers, and Yuanwu Keqin holds up the robe and says the ancients wore the grubby garment because they could not dodge it, and neither can he refuse this crowd. Ying'an Tanhua calls every word before the stroke grass-clinging and, with no way out, doctors the dead horse, Zhongfeng Mingben reopens the ancients' verse on mistaking the knowing spirit only because he cannot let it pass, Mingjue Cong would bite his teeth shut and twist his nose till the hall grew grass, yet with no way out faces the official's feast, and Yuan'an Liao reads the shout and the staff as first-order muddy-water kindness, then with no way out drags his hearers through mud and water on purpose.
